mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.project_id, s.name, s.goal, s.status, s.start_date, s.end_date, s.created_at, s.started_at, s.start_scope_hours, s.start_scope_issues, COALESCE(stats.total_issues, 0) AS total_issues, COALESCE(stats.done_issues, 0) AS done_issues, COALESCE(stats.in_progress_issues, 0) AS in_progress_issues, COALESCE(stats.todo_issues, 0) AS todo_issues, COALESCE(stats.overdue_issues, 0) AS overdue_issues, COALESCE(stats.unassigned_issues, 0) AS unassigned_issues, COALESCE(stats.total_estimated_hours, 0) AS total_estimated_hours, COALESCE(stats.completed_estimated_hours, 0) AS completed_estimated_hours FROM sprint s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT i.sprint_id, COUNT(*) AS total_issues, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ist.is_closed = true) AS done_issues, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ist.is_closed = false AND ist.category = 'in_progress') AS in_progress_issues, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ist.is_closed = false AND ist.category != 'in_progress') AS todo_issues, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ist.is_closed = false AND i.due_date IS NOT NULL AND i.due_date < CURRENT_DATE) AS overdue_issues, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.assignee_id IS NULL) AS unassigned_issues, COALESCE(SUM(i.estimated_hours), 0) AS total_estimated_hours, COALESCE(SUM(i.estimated_hours) FILTER (WHERE ist.is_closed = true), 0) AS completed_estimated_hours FROM issue i LEFT JOIN issue_status ist ON ist.id = i.status_id WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.sprint_id IN (SELECT sp.id FROM sprint sp WHERE sp.project_id = #{projectId}) GROUP BY i.sprint_id ) stats ON stats.sprint_id = s.id WHERE s.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY CASE s.status WHEN 'active' THEN 1 WHEN 'planned' THEN 2 WHEN 'completed' THEN 3 WHEN 'archived' THEN 4 END, CASE WHEN s.status = 'planned' THEN s.start_date ELSE NULL END ASC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN s.status != 'planned' THEN s.start_date ELSE NULL END DESC NULLS LAST, s.created_at DESC

SELECT s.id, s.project_id, s.name, s.goal, s.status, s.start_date, s.end_date, s.created_at, s.started_at, s.start_scope_hours, s.start_scope_issues, COALESCE(stats.total_issues, 0) AS total_issues, COALESCE(stats.done_issues, 0) AS done_issues, COALESCE(stats.in_progress_issues, 0) AS in_progress_issues, COALESCE(stats.todo_issues, 0) AS todo_issues, COALESCE(stats.overdue_issues, 0) AS overdue_issues, COALESCE(stats.unassigned_issues, 0) AS unassigned_issues, COALESCE(stats.total_estimated_hours, 0) AS total_estimated_hours, COALESCE(stats.completed_estimated_hours, 0) AS completed_estimated_hours FROM sprint s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT i.sprint_id, COUNT(*) AS total_issues, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ist.is_closed = true) AS done_issues, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ist.is_closed = false AND ist.category = 'in_progress') AS in_progress_issues, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ist.is_closed = false AND ist.category != 'in_progress') AS todo_issues, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ist.is_closed = false AND i.due_date IS NOT NULL AND i.due_date < CURRENT_DATE) AS overdue_issues, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.assignee_id IS NULL) AS unassigned_issues, COALESCE(SUM(i.estimated_hours), 0) AS total_estimated_hours, COALESCE(SUM(i.estimated_hours) FILTER (WHERE ist.is_closed = true), 0) AS completed_estimated_hours FROM issue i LEFT JOIN issue_status ist ON ist.id = i.status_id WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.sprint_id = #{sprintId} GROUP BY i.sprint_id ) stats ON stats.sprint_id = s.id WHERE s.id = #{sprintId}
SELECT i.id FROM issue i JOIN issue_status ist ON ist.id = i.status_id WHERE i.sprint_id = #{sprintId} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND ist.is_closed = false

SELECT i.id, i.issue_key, i.title, i.priority, ist.name AS status_name, ist.color AS status_color, u.display_name AS assignee_name FROM issue i JOIN issue_status ist ON ist.id = i.status_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = i.assignee_id WHERE i.sprint_id = #{sprintId} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND ist.is_closed = false ORDER BY i.created_at ASC

SELECT CAST(i.assignee_id AS VARCHAR) AS user_id, u.display_name, COUNT(*) AS issue_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ist.is_closed = true) AS done_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ist.is_closed = false AND ist.category = 'in_progress') AS in_progress_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ist.is_closed = false AND ist.category != 'in_progress') AS todo_count, COALESCE(SUM(i.estimated_hours), 0) AS estimated_hours_total FROM issue i LEFT JOIN issue_status ist ON ist.id = i.status_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = i.assignee_id WHERE i.sprint_id = #{sprintId} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY i.assignee_id, u.display_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

SELECT te.work_date AS workDate, SUM(te.duration) AS totalMinutes FROM time_entry te INNER JOIN issue i ON i.id = te.issue_id AND i.sprint_id = #{sprintId} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE te.duration IS NOT NULL GROUP BY te.work_date ORDER BY te.work_date
